 [&>div>p>iframe]:!h-auto [&>div>p>iframe]:!mx-auto [&>div>p>iframe]:min-w-[auto] [&>div>p>iframe]:lg:min-w-[382px] min-h-[200px] [&_ol]:list-decimal [&_ol]:list-outside [&_ol]:pl-[30px] [&_h3]:font-bold [&_h3]:text-xl [&_h3]:mb-8"> Sneako and DJ Akademiks have not been on good terms as of late. Their beef has been bubbling for a while, but it really took off when Ak exposed Sneako for gambling. This is an issue because Sneako has been extremely forthcoming about his Muslim faith. Gambling is a big no-no within the religion, and therefore, Ak believes the political streamer is a hypocrite.
 Akademiks has picked fights with some prominent figures over the years. More recently, he has been diving into streamer beef. People like Tylil are perfect examples of this. However, this beef with Sneako has gotten ugly, especially after what occurred last night.
 Adin Ross and his friend Cuffem hosted a call with Akademiks and Sneako. Instead of trying to hash out their issues, Sneako began crashing out on Ak. He told the hip-hop commentator that he made a living off "farming black death" and that he is a blight on society. He also alleged that Akademiks beats women and grooms 15-year-olds in Discord calls. +
 This became an all-out screaming match, with Akademiks replaying clips of Sneako revealing he went to a s*x party with his ex-girlfriend and watched her hook up with another man.
 Read More: A Jay-Z Halftime Show At The Super Bowl Is The NFL's Easy Way Out 
 Sneako Vs. DJ Akademiks
 For those confused by Sneako's allegations, these come from incidents that were well publicized. Firstly, Akademiks was accused of rape a couple of years ago and was even hit with a lawsui t. Meanwhile, there was a moment on stream where Akademiks was asking a 15-year-old some uncomfortable questions, which led to severe backlash.
 During the call, Akademiks didn't seem interested in responding to the allegations or explaining them. Instead, he tried to shout over Sneako and call him out for his own hypocrisy.
 Kick is a platform where these kinds of fights frequently manifest. If this had occurred on Twitch, there would have been some swift bans handed out.
 Now, Adin Ross is looking to get Akademiks and Sneako in the ring for a BrandRisk fight. If that were to happen, it would absolutely be must watch.
